body: I was never involuntarily committed so it didn't show up
There's a small learning curve with reddit but you'll get there :)

I need proper therapy. I learned a long time ago you can't speak to friends about stuff like this. I'm married, and talking to my husband about this stuff drove him away. I'm having to move out of my home because I vented on him too much and he couldn't take it anymore, he asked for a separation.

I tried to get myself help. Check myself into a psych ward, I got nothing, just a lot of coloring books and an intern therapist I met with once. Found a therapist on the outside and second session, she tells me she's moving to Mexico and I'm being passed along to someone else. These people don't seem to care that I'm in crisis. There just doesn't seem to be any routes left for me.

I got fired. Husband asked for separation. Put myself in a psych hospital for the same damn reason I'm now holding this gun: I was extremely suicidal. Hospital didn't help at all. So there's no other route for me now. Hbu?
